messages:
✓ `_codev/config.yaml` enriched.

The new `context:` and `rules:` blocks replace the one-line "TypeScript project." stub. The comment above `context:` now reads `# written by /codev-configure`, and `schema: spec-driven` and `language: en` are untouched. I checked that only that file changed, but I couldn't parse the YAML to confirm it's valid because that command needed approval.

What I read: `README.md`, `package.json`, `jest.config.js`, `tsconfig.json`, all four source files and both test files. The project has no `CONTRIBUTING.md`, no `docs/` and no CI workflow.

The `lint` script in `package.json` points at a root `__tests__/` folder that doesn't exist, because the tests live in `src/invoices/__tests__/`. ESLint fails on a path that doesn't exist, so `npm run lint` will probably fail even though the new rules tell tasks to run it. I didn't run it to confirm.

configure.before:
schema: spec-driven
language: en

# detected from package.json
context: |
  TypeScript project.
configure.after:
schema: spec-driven
language: en

# written by /codev-configure
context: |
  REST API on Express 4 (strict TypeScript, CommonJS), one folder per resource
  under src/ (src/invoices/: router.ts + store.ts). Request bodies are validated
  with zod `safeParse` in the router; a validation failure answers 400 with
  `{ issues }` listing every issue, success answers 201 with the created resource.
  Storage is an in-memory store class; amounts are integer cents (`amountCents`).
  `buildApp()` in src/app.ts is kept apart from src/server.ts so tests drive the
  app without opening a port. Comments are in English and explain the why.

rules:
  specs:
    - State each endpoint's method, path, status codes and response body shape, including the 400 `{ issues }` case.
  design:
    - Place a new resource in its own src/<resource>/ folder with a router.ts (zod schema + routes) and a store.ts, mounted in buildApp().
  tasks:
    - Each task states how to verify it is done (a named test or an npm script).
    - "Jest via ts-jest: tests in __tests__/ next to the code, named *.test.ts; store logic tested as unit tests, routes tested over HTTP with supertest on buildApp(); run npm test, npm run lint and npm run build."
